beats.title: The Town of Fang
beats.subtitle: Fang was just an ordinary town on the banks of the River Kok. Until Baron Sukumvit built the labyrinth.

beats.title: Baron Sukumvit
beats.subtitle: With the help of the townsfolk, Sukumvit built a maze deep beneath the mountain. From which there was only one way out.

beats.title: The Labyrinth
beats.subtitle: The labyrinth was filled with hideous monsters, deadly traps, and cunning tricks.

beats.title: The Ten Guards
beats.subtitle: Sukumvit sent his ten best guards to test the labyrinth. They were never seen again.

beats.title: The Trial of Champions
beats.subtitle: Ten thousand Gold Pieces for anyone who survived. Year after year, no one returned.

beats.title: The Challenge
beats.subtitle: Not for the reward. Simply because no one has ever done it. You intend to be the first.

beats.title: Arrival at Fang
beats.subtitle: Two days on foot and four by river bring you to Fang.

beats.title: The Last Night
beats.subtitle: The night before the Trial, the magnitude of the task begins to consume your thoughts.

beats.title: The Trumpet
beats.subtitle: A trumpet blast wakes you from dreams of flaming pits and giant spiders.

beats.title: The Five Rivals
beats.subtitle: A knight. An elf. Two barbarians. An assassin in the shadows. And you.

beats.title: The Walk
beats.subtitle: You fill your lungs with fresh air one last time. It is time to face the Deathtrap Dungeon.
